og.h1: Three of the Big Four post half of India's risk and compliance openings. EY alone posts 30.8%.
og.foot: Share of 1,868 risk and compliance openings in India · himyro.com

slides.h1: Learning Python for a risk job? Only 2.4% of titles say analytics.
slides.sub: 50.5% of India's risk openings are at EY, Deloitte and KPMG.
slides.caption: Learning Python for a risk job? Only 2.4% of risk and compliance titles in India say analytics. 50.5% of the openings are at EY, Deloitte and KPMG.

slides.headline: Most risk openings ask for regulation and audit instead.
head: Named in the postings

slides.caption: Most risk openings ask for regulation and audit instead: 67.2% of postings name regulation and 50.6% audit. Python appears in 11.0%.

slides.headline: At the Big Four, your CA counts more than anywhere else.
slides.sub: of Big Four risk postings name a CA. At EY, 34.8%. At banks, 14.2%.
slides.caption: At the Big Four, your CA counts more than anywhere else: 25.9% of their risk postings name one, and 34.8% of EY's. At banks and financial firms, 14.2%.

slides.headline: Want a bank instead? Go to Axis, in Mumbai.
slides.sub: of all risk openings are Axis Bank's. 73.2% of them are in Mumbai.
slides.caption: Want a bank instead? Axis Bank posts 12.4% of all risk openings, and 73.2% of its roles are in Mumbai.

slides.headline: Starting out? A bank is the shorter door.
slides.sub: of risk roles at banks are entry level. At the Big Four, 5.1%.
slides.caption: Starting out? A bank is the shorter door: 13.8% of risk roles at banks and financial firms are entry level, against 5.1% at the Big Four.

slides.headline: Still set on analytics? Those roles ask for Python and SAS.
head: Named in the postings

slides.caption: Still set on analytics? Inside those titles, Python is in 51.1% and SAS in 33.3%. Across all risk postings, 11.0% and 2.8%.
